name: phason_stiffness_ratio
tier: Tier 2 integer identification (D=18) + Tier 3 heuristic stiffness-ratio map

extra.derivation_note: The Gram-determinant ratio det(G_perp)/det(G_para) = phi^-6 is a raw-frame (coordinate-dependent) algebraic identity of the cut-and-project lattice basis: it scales as s^6 under an internal rescaling and the canonical isometric projectors give 1, so its cube does not derive a stiffness ratio (the former Gram-cube route is retired, App DPS §DPS.3). The exponent 18 is the H_3 invariant-degree sum (App DPS §DPS.4), the Tier 2 integer identification; the map K_perp/K_para = phi^-18 is the Tier 3 P3b hypothesis (O.15(b)), registered outside the count.
